author: A3_XAUUSD_IBKR_RESEARCHER
motivation: the 2026-09-16 TWS episode (TCP open, API handshake dead, classified NOT_RUN_TWS_UNAVAILABLE, resumable) proves a multi-day probe MUST survive session and app restarts without fabricating intervals.

files_layout.state_file: probes/state/probe_state.json (small, rewritten atomically: write tmp + fsync + rename)
files_layout.data_files: probes/data/samples_<yyyymmdd>.jsonl (append-only, one JSON object per observed tick sample)
files_layout.events_file: probes/data/events_<yyyymmdd>.jsonl (append-only: CONNECT, RESYNC, GAP_OPEN, GAP_CLOSE, RESUME, PACING_VIOLATION, HALT, SHUTDOWN)

state_file_schema.contract_frozen_sha256: sha256 of probe_contract_draft.json at freeze (written at freeze; mismatch on resume = HALT)
state_file_schema.server_time_offset_ms: last measured IBKR-server minus local wall clock
state_file_schema.sample_seq: monotonic last assigned sequence number (never reset, never reused)

byte_offsets.commit_protocol: append line(s) -> flush -> fsync -> then update state_file byte offset -> atomic rename; the offset in state is ALWAYS <= true file size
byte_offsets.why: a crash between append and fsync leaves file longer than committed offset; the excess is UNCOMMITTED and must not be claimed as evidence

heartbeat_contract_Q13.cadence: every 60 s of sampler runtime and at every state transition (connect, gap open/close, window start/end, shutdown)

payload.state_digest: sha256 of state_file contents at hb time

heartbeat_contract_Q13.purpose: an external watcher (or the successor) can verify liveness by (a) hb_seq monotonicity, (b) bytes_written growing, (c) payload_shape matching the declared schema - a heartbeat with wrong shape or frozen bytes is an alarm, not proof of life

clean_stop: 1. write SHUTDOWN event; 2. close current OPEN window with status; 3. fsync all jsonl files; 4. write final byte offsets; 5. atomic state rename
resume: 1. read probe_state.json; verify schema_id and contract_frozen_sha256 (mismatch => HALT, do not collect)
2. verify instrument fingerprint via contractDetails (identity re-check; minTick must match frozen 0.01)
3. stat each data file: if file_size > committed_bytes, TRUNCATE back to committed_bytes (uncommitted tail from a crash is discarded, never claimed) - record a TRUNCATION event
4. resync server time via reqCurrentTime BEFORE first sample; log RESYNC with new offset
5. open a GAP record for the offline interval [last_good_server_ts, now] with cause = the shutdown/disconnect reason; the gap is RECORDED, never backfilled
6. write RESUME event; continue with a fresh sample_seq continuing the monotonic counter
non_fabrication_invariants: NO sample line may be synthesized for any interval the sampler was not observably running
any interval with zero samples because the app was down is a GAP record, not interpolated data
server_ts is authoritative; a resumed session never merges samples across a break within the same second
coverage_by_session counts only observed samples; expected-minus-observed is reported as missing, never filled
stop_resume_algorithm.crash_mid_write: a torn final JSON line (< committed region) is detected by parse failure at the last offset and truncated with a TRUNCATION_TORN_LINE event

atomicity.state_rewrites: tmp file + fsync + atomic rename (no in-place mutation)
atomicity.jsonl_appends: single write() per line, flush + fsync before offset commit
atomicity.lock: single-writer only; probe takes the workspace heavy-job lock per AGENTS.md before any collection session
